data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment for 2025. Your tax is €11,405.00, and €10,771.00 was already withheld through payroll, so you owe €634.00. Pay it by 30 April 2026 to the account shown. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office in writing, via ELSTER or in person for the record; the app shows until when. Otherwise the assessment becomes final. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
